name: Personalized Web Agent Benchmark (PersonalWAB)
description: PersonalWAB is a benchmark for evaluating large language model empowered personalized web agents, integrating personalized user data and instructions to assess personalized instruction comprehension and action execution across three web tasks.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that appears to be early-stage and not yet broadly adopted in the community.
notes: Includes two evaluation paradigms across three personalized web tasks; addresses lack of benchmarks for personalized web agents.
